translations.web: But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly as this? For all things come from you, and we have given you of your own.
translations.bsb: But who am I, and who are my people, that we should be able to give as generously as this? For everything comes from You, and from Your own hand we have given to You.
